metadata.title: MCP-MacOSControl Plan of Action and Milestones

poam-items.title: AppleScript security filter regex bypass class (SECURITY.md §4.1)
poam-items.description: Accepted residual risk: the AppleScriptSecurityFilter is a regex denylist applied after comment and string-literal stripping. Four documented bypass classes (string-concat reconstruction, Unicode normalization, dynamic run script with tell-application return value, comment-split that re-forms the keyword) are not statically detectable. Risk is accepted on the basis of compensating controls: STORY-024 audit hook (every invocation including filter-passes is logged with a tamper-evident chain), macOS TCC per-app automation gates, MCP host destructiveHint user-confirmation gate.

props.name: re-evaluation-criterion
props.value: A credible Swift AST parser for AppleScript becomes available, or a post-incident review identifies an exploited bypass in this class.

milestones.title: STORY-025 fuzz harness operational
milestones.description: Measured bypass-class coverage from the AppleScript fuzz harness reaches ≥80% of documented bypass classes; results published as a CI artifact and reviewed by the security owner.

milestones.title: Quarterly re-review of bypass class catalog
milestones.description: Security owner reviews docs/SECURITY.md §4.1 bypass class list against published AppleScript research and incident reports; new classes are added or the item closes if all four are addressed.

poam-items.remarks: status: risk-accepted. Owner: security-owner. Re-evaluation criterion: STORY-025 fuzz harness coverage ≥80% OR exploited bypass observed in the wild. Cross-references: oscal/component-definition.json si-10 statements si-10_smt.bypass-{string-concat,unicode,dynamic-run-script,comment-split}.

poam-items.title: Single-secret exfiltration via stdout (SECURITY.md §4.2)
poam-items.description: Accepted residual risk: the 1 MB output truncation cap bounds bulk exfiltration but does not prevent a single targeted read (e.g. one password from Notes, one API key from a clipboard manager). Justified because AI agents have legitimate reasons to read user data on the user's behalf; the user's choice to launch the server combined with the MCP host's confirmation gate is the consent model. The AuditRecorder captures the invocation (script SHA-256, timestamp, target apps), providing forensics for incident response.

props.name: re-evaluation-criterion
props.value: A practical intent-classification approach to AI tool calls becomes available, or a deployer engagement requires per-tool data-classification gates.

milestones.title: Intent-classification feasibility review
milestones.description: Security owner publishes a short feasibility note on whether intent classification of agent-issued tool calls is tractable given current model capabilities and the project's threat model. Outcome either adds milestones to this item or formalizes long-term acceptance.

poam-items.remarks: status: risk-accepted. Owner: security-owner. Cross-reference: oscal/component-definition.json ac-4 implementation statement (1 MB truncation cap).

poam-items.title: Dynamic-name TCC prompts in CI (SECURITY.md §4.3)
poam-items.description: Accepted residual risk: AppleScript scripts that build target app names dynamically (e.g. `tell application name1 & " " & name2`) cannot be statically extracted by AutomationPermissionChecker. The pre-flight check returns .skipped for these and the runtime TCC prompt becomes the gate. In CI this can manifest as a hung process waiting on a modal. Mitigation: pre-grant automation permission for fixture apps used in integration tests; treat TCC prompts in production as an expected user touchpoint.

props.name: re-evaluation-criterion
props.value: A reliable AppleScript identifier-resolution approach for dynamic names ships, or a CI hang attributable to this class is observed in the integration suite.

milestones.title: Integration-suite TCC pre-grant verification
milestones.description: docs/INTEGRATION-CI-SETUP.md documents the signed-helper TCC grant path; verify the helper is provisioned on all CI runners and that the integration suite exits non-zero (not hang) on a missing grant.

poam-items.remarks: status: risk-accepted. Owner: security-owner. Cross-reference: docs/INTEGRATION-CI-SETUP.md.

poam-items.title: Audit log: no per-record HSM signing (SECURITY.md §4.4)
poam-items.description: Acknowledged residual risk: per-record digital signatures would be stronger than the hash chain but signing requires key management; a stored key on the host is no harder to compromise than the host itself. STORY-024 chain + off-host shipping pair provides two independent corroborations (on-disk chain + remote sink's collected copy). Re-evaluation criterion is an HSM-backed signing path becoming available or a post-incident review identifying a class of tampering the chain misses.

props.name: re-evaluation-criterion
props.value: Credible HSM-backed signing path becomes available, or post-incident review identifies tampering class the chain misses.

milestones.title: HSM-signing feasibility review
milestones.description: Security owner publishes a short feasibility note on local HSM availability (Secure Enclave, smartcard, YubiKey) for per-record AuditRecord signing. Outcome either adds milestones or formalizes long-term acceptance.

poam-items.remarks: status: risk-accepted. Owner: security-owner. Cross-reference: oscal/component-definition.json au-9 statement au-9_smt.no-hsm-signing.

poam-items.title: Deferred production audit sink (SECURITY.md §4.4, closed by STORY-024)
poam-items.description: Historical accepted risk: prior to Sprint 6, the AuditRecorder was an in-memory protocol seam suitable for development and CI but not for production. Closed by STORY-024, which shipped a hash-chained, retained, off-host-shipping production sink (OSLog default, HTTP/syslog optional). The on-disk JSONL stream is append-only at the storage layer; AuditChainVerifier runs on server start, on every retention sweep, and on operator demand.
poam-items.remarks: status: closed. Closed-by: STORY-024 (hash-chained, retained, off-host audit log). Closure evidence: Sources/MacOSControlLib/AppleScript/Audit/{AuditStorage,AuditChainVerifier,AuditRemoteSink,AuditRetentionSweeper}.swift; Tests/MCP-MacOSControlTests/AppleScript/Audit/{AuditChainTests,AuditChainPropertyTests,FileAuditStorageTests,AuditRetentionTests}.swift; docs/AUDIT-LOG-OPERATIONS.md.

poam-items.title: Audit hash-chain integrity failure (auto-opened by oscal-emit)
poam-items.description: Auto-opened by oscal-emit whenever the AuditRecord stream contains a chain_verification_failure event. Each occurrence elevates the corresponding observation and adds a related-observation reference here so an assessor can pivot from the AR to the affected operational incident.

milestones.title: Incident response: investigate latest chain break
milestones.description: Operator runs verify_audit_chain, identifies the first-break record id, examines the chain offset, and either confirms benign cause (clock skew during archive rotation) or escalates per docs/AUDIT-LOG-OPERATIONS.md incident-response checklist.

poam-items.remarks: status: open. Owner: security-owner. UUID is the deterministic chain-break risk UUID emitted by OscalObservationEmitter. Cross-reference: docs/AUDIT-LOG-OPERATIONS.md.
